verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source email client, so official SDKs are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no SDK in any language. The closest items are an official MCP server (a separate story's capability) and a generic 'Developer-Friendly – Built with extensibility and integrations in mind' claim, which are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
